70c604e71f1f50cb.description: Job Summary: PayLink is seeking a Risk Manager to lead its Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) function as an independent control function. You will develop and maintain the risk management framework, assess risks across the business, and provide clear insights that support informed decisions, business resilience, and compliance with applicable Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) requirements. The role works closely with senior management, relevant committees, and departmental risk owners while maintaining independent oversight and clear accountability. Key Responsibilities: 1. Governance, Strategy and Risk Management Framework Develop and update the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, policies, methodologies, tools and templates, and submit them for approval under the delegation of authority. Prepare an annual risk management strategy and work plan aligned with the Company’s strategy, license category and scale of operations. Define roles, responsibilities, escalation lines, risk owners and control owners in coordination with relevant departments, without imposing unapproved operational authority. Support the Risk Committee and relevant committees by preparing materials and reports and tracking decisions within each committee’s mandate. Review the framework periodically following product, business model or regulatory changes or material events. 2. Risk Identification, Assessment and Risk Register Lead enterprise assessments of inherent and residual risk in collaboration with departmental risk owners. Establish and maintain the enterprise risk register, documenting causes, impacts, controls, assessments, treatment owners and target dates. Coordinate Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) and challenge the reasonableness of assessments against available evidence. Assess enterprise risks arising from new products and services, material changes, projects, expansion and partnerships before recommendations are submitted. Conduct scenario analyses and stress testing in line with priorities, capabilities and available data, in coordination with Finance, Operations and Technology. 3. Risk Appetite, Indicators and Reporting Develop and review the risk appetite statement and tolerance limits in coordination with Finance, Compliance, Operations, Cybersecurity and other stakeholders, and submit them to the authorized approving body. Develop a proportionate set of Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), defining data sources, data owners, measurement frequency and alert thresholds. Monitor risk appetite breaches, analyze their causes, recommend mitigation and escalate under approved authorities. Produce concise periodic reports for senior management and relevant committees on material risks, trends, breaches, remediation plans and decisions required. 4. Control Assessment and Independent Challenge Assess control design adequacy and effectiveness from a risk management perspective, using supporting evidence, test results, reports, interviews and appropriate samples. Request information and evidence necessary for risk assessments within approved access rights, need-to-know principles, confidentiality and data protection requirements. Document professional disagreements with risk or control owners and escalate material matters through approved channels. Do not operate controls, make specialist operational decisions or substitute for Internal Audit’s independent assurance role. 5. Financial, Operational, Technology and Financial Crime Risks Monitor risks relating to liquidity, settlements, partner banks, fraud, operations, third parties, concentration, reputation and strategy in coordination with their respective owners. Assess cybersecurity and technology risks within the enterprise framework in coordination with Cybersecurity and Technology, without assuming their specialist or operational responsibilities. Include money laundering, terrorist financing and proliferation financing risks in the enterprise risk register and independently challenge exposures, controls and residual risk in coordination with Compliance and the AML officer. Access appropriate transaction, alert and suspicion-related indicators for risk assessment, subject to confidentiality restrictions on reports and protected case files; this role does not include investigating individual cases or making regulatory reporting decisions. Ensure enterprise assessments align with specialist risk assessments without creating conflicting assessments or transferring ownership of specialist programs to Risk Management. 6. Business Continuity and Crisis Management Oversee the Business Continuity Management (BCM) framework and program through the Business Continuity Officer and relevant functions, monitoring plans, testing and remediation readiness. Review Business Impact Analysis (BIA) results, verify business owners’ validation of impacts and dependencies, and confirm that Technology and Operations have assessed recovery target feasibility. Monitor business continuity, disaster recovery and crisis management plans and tests, while operational response and recovery remain with designated teams. Report material readiness gaps to senior management and relevant committees, coordinating with Compliance on regulatory notifications. 7. Third Parties, Changes and Projects Assess risks relating to suppliers, outsourcing, third-party dependencies, concentration and single points of failure in collaboration with relationship owners. Review risks associated with projects, material changes and new services and provide recommendations before approval. Track risk mitigation plans, action owners and deadlines without executing other departments’ remedial actions. 8. Regulatory Requirements, Coordination and Awareness Monitor regulatory requirements applicable to the risk management function and compile supporting evidence with Compliance and relevant stakeholders. Participate in supervisory visits and respond on enterprise risk management topics using validated information, referring specialist technical topics to their owners. Track regulatory and Internal Audit findings relevant to Risk Management and verify remediation by responsible owners. Deliver practical risk awareness and training to risk owners and promote risk culture throughout the Company. Maintain orderly records of evidence, assessments, reports, decisions and relevant correspondence. Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification is preferred. Preferably at least seven years of relevant experience in risk management, governance, or financial services, including leadership experience, subject to applicable fit-and-proper requirements. Practical experience within financial institutions or payment service providers supervised by the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA). Working knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), risk appetite, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), Business Continuity Management (BCM), internal controls, and regulatory reporting. Relevant professional credentials, such as FRM, CRMP, RIMS-CRMP, or an ISO 31000-related qualification, are preferred and complement practical experience. Strong analytical judgment and independent assessment skills, with the ability to connect risk exposures to business objectives and regulatory impact. Effective communication, cross-functional coordination, and professional conflict management skills. Ability to prepare clear executive reports and provide practical, actionable recommendations. Strong planning and prioritization skills, including tracking remediation activities within available resources. Ability to evaluate evidence and data while maintaining the confidentiality of sensitive information. Leadership and coaching skills, with the ability to strengthen risk culture and influence stakeholders without direct line authority.

70d55494fd8a6b41.description: About the Role Wusool Advertising Corporation is seeking a Performance Marketing Specialist to manage paid advertising campaigns. Key Responsibilities Set up, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across platforms including Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, X, Google, and YouTube. Define target audiences and allocate advertising budgets effectively. Monitor campaign performance and track key performance indicators (KPIs). Prepare campaign performance reports and analyze results. Conduct A/B testing to improve campaign effectiveness. Optimize advertising costs and maximize campaign performance. 701a362b3056646d.description: Director, Cost Planning - General Business Unit Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Director - Cost Planning for its General Business Unit in Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves leading cost planning for major General, commercial, and mixed-use developments, ensuring the Qiddiya cost position is maintained across a portfolio of complex projects. The Director will guide strategic design-to-budget decisions and support executive and Stage Gate approvals, integrating cost planning into business and project decision-making. Role Purpose and Context The primary purpose of this role is to lead cost planning activities for the General Business Unit across assigned portfolios, programs, and major projects. This includes ensuring consistent application of the Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, effective leadership of cost consultants, robust cost governance, and providing high-quality strategic cost advice to support project, business, procurement, and Stage Gate decision-making. The role directs, reviews, and challenges the work of external cost consultants and internal project teams, and may manage Qiddiya cost planning resources. Key Responsibilities Lead cost planning activities for major General Business Unit projects and portfolios, aligning with approved budgets, strategic objectives, and risk assessments. Direct the appointment, mobilization, governance, and performance management of executive and project cost consultants. Provide leadership, oversight, and line management for Qiddiya cost planning resources assigned to the General Business Unit. Establish requirements for consultant deliverables, methodologies, reporting standards, and cost planning assumptions. Review, validate, and challenge consultant cost plans, reconciliations, benchmarks, and design-to-budget recommendations. Provide senior cost planning assurance for Stage Gate submissions, investment decisions, and procurement strategies. Maintain a current, defensible, and evidence-based cost position across assigned projects and portfolios. Lead strategic design-to-budget decision-making by identifying major cost drivers and advising on cost implications. Provide early-stage and portfolio-level cost advice using approved benchmarks and market intelligence. Collaborate with development, design, commercial, finance, procurement, and project management stakeholders. Apply cost planning software, benchmark data, and quantity-based review methods to interrogate consultant outputs. Represent the General Business Unit in cost planning, governance, and executive forums. Qualifications and Requirements Minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in cost planning, quantity surveying, or estimating, with significant experience in major General or mixed-use developments. Demonstrated experience leading external cost consultants and reviewing consultant-produced cost plans across multiple design, procurement, and delivery stages. Strong knowledge of cost planning governance, benchmarking, design-to-budget principles, phasing, risk and contingency management, inflation, escalation, and cost reporting. Advanced proficiency in cost planning software and digital tools for reviewing and validating cost plans. Professional membership with RICS, AIQS, or an equivalent body is preferred. Experience operating within complex stakeholder environments, major governance frameworks, and executive decision-making settings is preferred. Key Performance Measures Assigned projects and portfolios maintain a documented and current cost position. Cost planning inputs for governance submissions comply with Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines and are provided within required timeframes. Consultant-produced cost plans are reviewed and challenged at key stages, with clear recommendations recorded. Qiddiya cost planning resources are effectively managed, with clear priorities and consistent standards. Material cost movement, cost risk, and non-compliance issues are identified and escalated promptly. Stakeholder Engagement The Director will interface with General Business Unit leadership and project teams, the Central Development Unit Cost Planning team, Development Management General and Stage Gate stakeholders, design management teams, commercial, procurement, finance, project management, and operations functions, as well as executive and project cost consultants. Effective coordination and strong leadership in these interactions are crucial for success.

708f12e9815f0b66.description: About the Role People Group is seeking a City Operations Director to establish and lead the operational framework for a new development in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time executive role involves building the City Operations function from the ground up, defining how the urban destination will operate as an integrated, smart, and sustainable environment. The successful candidate will report directly to the CEO. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the overall City Operations strategy, vision, and operating model. Establish the City Operations department, including its organizational structure, governance frameworks, policies, and operational standards. Oversee the operational strategy for district cooling systems and associated energy infrastructure, ensuring efficiency and sustainability. Lead the development and implementation of the Smart City operations strategy, integrating smart infrastructure, IoT, and digital platforms. Develop and implement an integrated city mobility and transportation operations strategy, including parking, traffic, and public transport management. Establish and oversee the delivery of all city-wide operational services, such as public realm maintenance, waste management, security, and community services. Lead the development of the operational readiness and mobilization strategy, ensuring infrastructure and services are fully commissioned. Establish operational budgets, cost management strategies, and commercial performance frameworks, including procurement and contract management. Build and maintain relationships with government entities, regulators, utility providers, and strategic partners. Operational Focus Areas The role involves strategic oversight across several critical operational domains: District Cooling & Utilities Management: Ensuring efficient, reliable, and sustainable cooling operations and utility coordination. Smart City & Technology Integration: Overseeing the integration of smart infrastructure, IoT, and digital platforms, and establishing centralized monitoring capabilities. Mobility, Traffic & Parking Management: Developing strategies for integrated city mobility, traffic flow, parking operations, and public transport interfaces. Integrated City Services & Infrastructure Operations: Managing public realm, infrastructure maintenance, waste management, security, and community services. Candidate Profile We are seeking a senior operations leader with a proven track record in establishing and managing complex, large-scale urban environments, integrated infrastructure, or major destination operations. The ideal candidate will have over 10 years of relevant experience. Required Qualifications and Experience Significant senior leadership experience in city operations, urban operations, integrated infrastructure management, or large-scale destination operations. Experience establishing an operational function, operating model, and governance framework from inception. Strong exposure to district cooling, utilities, smart city infrastructure, and integrated technology platforms. Experience overseeing parking, mobility, traffic management, and public realm operations. A strong understanding of integrated service delivery and the management of multiple operational functions. Application Information This is a full-time position based in Jeddah. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

70b6eb1cb599bd2b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مدارس ربوع الحكمة العالمية عن مساعد صحي للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم الأساسي للأطباء والممرضين في رعاية المرضى، سواء في البيئات المنزلية أو المستشفيات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهنيين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المساعد الصحي مجموعة من المهام لدعم الرعاية اليومية للمرضى، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: تحضير المرضى للفحوصات أو العلاج، وتجهيز الأدوات اللازمة للطبيب. تغيير أغطية الأسرة، ومساعدة المرضى في النظافة الشخصية وارتداء وخلع الملابس، وضمان راحتهم. تقديم الوجبات للمرضى في الأوقات المحددة ضمن الجدول الزمني. تسجيل العلامات الحيوية للمرضى وإعطاء الأدوية وفقًا للتعليمات. تنظيف وتطهير الأدوات الطبية حسب الإرشادات المتبعة. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الرعاية الصحية أو دور مماثل. القدرة على أداء المهام الأساسية لدعم الأطباء والممرضين. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإرشادات الطبية بدقة. بيئة العمل يعمل المساعد الصحي ضمن بيئة رعاية صحية ديناميكية، تتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع المرضى والتعاون مع فريق طبي متكامل. يقع مكان العمل في حائل، وتوفر مدارس ربوع الحكمة العالمية بيئة داعمة لنمو المهنيين. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، مما يتطلب التزامًا كاملاً بالمهام والمسؤوليات المحددة لضمان تقديم أفضل مستويات الرعاية للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. نشجع المرشحين المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

702f944368bda8aa.description: About the Role ALPLA Group is seeking a Purchasing Administrator to join our team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is essential for managing procurement processes, ensuring timely acquisition of materials and services, and maintaining strong supplier relationships. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience in a purchasing or administrative capacity. Key Responsibilities Coordinate with planning and functional departments to ensure timely requests for necessary items. Prioritize and issue all purchase orders (POs) without delay. Negotiate prices and submit price comparisons to Operations Managers (OMs) for approval. Source various materials and services. Maintain up-to-date supplier records and purchasing databases. Track all POs and provide regular updates to OMs. Implement a system to track goods and services POs to ensure on-time delivery. Identify and report potential risks such as price increases or material shortages due to supplier issues. Update the price matrix on a monthly basis. Ensure a minimum of three suppliers for each item. Maintain accurate records of all purchasing processes. Verify that all purchase orders comply with company policy. Reduce discrepancies between the Purchase Requisition (PSR), Purchase Order (PO), and Goods Receipt (RIR) processes. Order materials and services based on negotiated and approved quotations. Review quotations and report any discrepancies. Maintain current procurement files. Manage petty cash and reconcile reports promptly. Handle all types of purchase orders, including forging and local purchases. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a purchasing or administrative role. Demonstrated ability to negotiate prices and manage supplier relationships. Proficiency in maintaining accurate records and databases. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to work effectively with various departments. Work Environment and Benefits Working with ALPLA Group offers a modern and family-oriented work environment. The Purchasing Administrator will be integrated into a dynamic team, undertaking challenging tasks with a high degree of self-responsibility. Individual performance is recognized and supported for further development.

70dfb0e3289f9b25.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تركيب ومراقبة وصيانة المكونات الكهربائية الأساسية، وتقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها. تقديم المساعدة للمهندسين الكهربائيين في تشخيص وحل المشكلات الفنية. تحديد المخطط، وتقدير كمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين فيما يتعلق بأعمال التركيب الكهربائي. اختبار النظم بعد تركيبها لضمان التقيد بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة. مهام الصيانة والتشخيص القيام بعمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة. تشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو الصيانة الكهربائية. فهم جيد للمخططات الكهربائية والمواصفات الفنية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وإصلاحها بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص، مما يتطلب مهارات تواصل وتعاون جيدة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه في الوقت الحالي. للمهتمين، يرجى تقديم طلبات التوظيف عبر القنوات المتاحة.

701467531e1ca242.description: About the Role Alfanar is seeking a Mechatronics & Automation Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves designing, developing, integrating, and validating advanced mechatronic, robotic, and automated systems, including construction automation solutions, within a multidisciplinary R&D environment. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on delivering innovative, reliable, and cost-effective solutions throughout the development lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Translate operational requirements into technical specifications and system architectures, integrating mechanical, electrical, electronic, embedded, control, and software subsystems. Conduct engineering calculations, feasibility studies, design reviews, and risk assessments to optimize performance, reliability, safety, manufacturability, and cost. Develop mechanical concepts, mechanisms, assemblies, and structural interfaces, preparing 3D models, 2D manufacturing drawings, and Bills of Materials (BOMs). Design electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, control-panel layouts, and system interfaces, including calculating electrical loads and selecting components. Develop and troubleshoot PLC programs, control sequences, interlocks, and alarms. Program, configure, calibrate, and integrate industrial and collaborative robots, developing motion paths and sensor-based operations. Integrate embedded firmware, electronic circuits, hardware interfaces, and PCB systems. Select and calibrate sensors, instrumentation, and feedback systems, integrating HMI/GUI applications, APIs, data logging, diagnostics, and automated controls. Prepare technical specifications for suppliers, evaluate components and quotations, and coordinate with procurement to resolve technical issues. Assemble, configure, test, and commission prototypes and automated systems, executing test plans to verify functionality, accuracy, performance, reliability, and safety. Maintain engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, test records, and BOMs, preparing operating instructions and maintenance procedures. General Accountabilities Continuously enhance technical knowledge, engineering competencies, and professional skills through training and knowledge-sharing activities. Complete assigned tasks within agreed schedules, budgets, and quality requirements, utilizing resources efficiently and reporting deviations. Take ownership of assigned tasks, proactively address technical and operational challenges, and escalate risks affecting safety, quality, cost, or project delivery. Ensure compliance with approved specifications, procedures, and quality standards, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including engineering, project management, procurement, production, quality, and operations. Comply with company policies, document-control procedures, confidentiality requirements, and intellectual property protection. Apply applicable Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) requirements during design, assembly, testing, and commissioning, identifying and reporting hazards. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in mechatronics and automation engineering. Demonstrated ability to combine mechanical, electrical, electronic, embedded systems, control systems, and software engineering principles. Experience in the full development lifecycle, from requirements definition to commissioning and continuous improvement. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, operating within a multidisciplinary R&D environment focused on innovative solutions.

705272e6db82d321.description: نبحث عن مصمم جرافيك مبدع للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تطوير هويتنا البصرية. ستكون مسؤولاً عن إنشاء تصاميم جذابة للمواد التسويقية والإعلانية الرقمية والمطبوعة. إذا كنت شغوفًا بالتصميم ولديك سجل حافل بالإبداع، ندعوك للتقديم. المهام والمسؤوليات: * تصميم الشعارات، الهويات البصرية، والمواد التسويقية المختلفة. * إنشاء تصاميم جذابة لمنصات التواصل الاجتماعي والحملات الإعلانية. * التعاون مع فريق التسويق لتنفيذ الأفكار الإبداعية وتحقيق الأهداف. * العمل على تحسين وتطوير التصاميم الحالية.

This role focuses on mechanical engineering expertise, particularly within Shutdown / Turnaround (SD/TA) projects. The position is based in the Eastern Region, covering cities such as Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Al Jubail, Al-Ahsa, Al Qatif, Buqayq, and Ras Tannurah. Manage and maintain various mechanical static equipment, including heat exchangers, columns, pressure vessels, reactors, and pipelines. Utilize Primavera P6 for project scheduling and management. 70b5f61778cf39fb.description: About the Role Sheraton is seeking a Cook III to join its culinary team. This full-time position involves preparing and cooking food items according to established recipes and quality standards, ensuring adherence to food safety and presentation guidelines. The role requires attention to detail in food preparation and maintaining a clean, organized workstation. Key Responsibilities Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and proper storage of food items. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables, and accurately weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Cook and prepare food according to specified recipes, quality standards, and presentation guidelines, utilizing a food preparation checklist. Prepare cold food items as required. Operate various kitchen equipment including ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to ensure they are cooked sufficiently and monitor food quality throughout the preparation process. Set up and break down the workstation efficiently. Serve food in correct portions using appropriate receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen areas, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of appliance and food temperatures. Safety and Compliance Adhere to all company and safety and security policies and procedures. Report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Teamwork and Professionalism Communicate with colleagues using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with team members. Support the team in achieving common goals and respond appropriately to concerns from other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards in all tasks. 704fa08d7d41db79.description: About the Role Bechtel Corporation is seeking a Risk Lead to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Bechtel will manage the infrastructure program for the six-square-kilometer Masterplan, which includes early works, utilities, and publicly accessible spaces. Key Responsibilities Lead and facilitate project risk and opportunity reviews and issue review sessions with various stakeholders including PMC, ERC, Project Controls, Planning, Commercial, Engineering, Procurement, and Construction teams. Challenge risk owners and action owners on the adequacy, practicality, and expected effectiveness of mitigation and recovery actions. Monitor overdue and ageing actions, follow up with accountable owners, identify barriers to completion, and escalate material delays or ineffective responses to the Risk Manager. Confirm that proposed action closures are supported by evidence and that residual exposure has been reassessed before recommending closure. Identify cross-project and programme-level risks and support their consolidation, escalation, and de-escalation. Develop, validate, run, and maintain Quantitative Schedule Risk Analysis (QSRA) models in Safran Risk for individual projects and consolidated programme analysis. Work with Planning and Project Controls teams to confirm that schedules used for QSRA are logically sound, appropriately status, and suitable for probabilistic analysis. Interpret QSRA outputs, including key drivers, criticality, probability distributions, and confidence dates, and prepare clear management-level conclusions and recommendations. Support the Risk Manager in implementing the risk management plan, governance, escalation criteria, assurance checks, workshops, and continuous improvement activities. Provide timely, quality-assured risk, issue, action, escalation, and QSRA inputs to the Risk Analyst for recurring and ad hoc client reporting. Coach the Risk Analyst and project stakeholders on risk data quality, reporting requirements, ARM usage, and consistent application of the approved risk process. Action ageing and effectiveness analysis, including overdue-action escalation recommendations. Project and programme QSRA models, assumptions logs, model validation records, sensitivity outputs, and management summaries. Consolidated project-to-programme risk inputs, emerging-risk themes, and escalation recommendations. Quality-assured source data and commentary for weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting. Working Interfaces and Performance Expectations The Risk Lead will interface with the Risk Manager, programme/project leadership teams, PMC and ERC project teams, risk owners, issue owners, action owners, and various functional teams including Project Controls, Planning, Cost, Commercial, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, HSE, Quality, and stakeholder management. Collaboration with the Risk Analyst for reporting, dashboard, data-quality, and client-submission inputs is also essential. Performance expectations include ensuring risk and issue information is current, evidence-based, and suitable for project and programme decision-making. Actions must be specific, owned, time-bound, monitored, and challenged for effectiveness before closure. Required reports and analysis are to be delivered accurately and in accordance with the agreed reporting calendar, with stakeholder engagement being proactive, professional, and focused on resolving risk and issue exposure.

Ensure compliance with OEM warranty policies, transit damage procedures, stockyard controls, and pre-delivery audit requirements. 700fd6c61e3d86d3.description: Job Purpose Prepare accurate, comprehensive, and competitive cost estimates for integrated facilities management tenders, covering hard and soft services. The role involves detailed tender review, site assessments, clarification of requirements, coordination with technical writers and suppliers, and preparation of cost submissions, presentations, and project handover documentation. Key Duties and Responsibilities 1. Tender Review and Clarifications Review RFPs in detail, including scopes of work, specifications, asset registers, drawings, bills of quantities, service levels, KPIs, contractual requirements, and tender addenda. Identify all requirements affecting project delivery and pricing, including scope gaps, ambiguities, exclusions, dependencies, and commercial risks. Prepare and maintain a tender compliance checklist to ensure all applicable requirements are addressed in the estimate. Attend Job Explanation Meetings (JobEx), pre-bid meetings, and client clarification sessions. Prepare, consolidate, and track tender queries, ensuring that client responses and amendments are reflected in the estimate and technical proposal. 2. Site Visits and Assessments Attend tender-related site visits anywhere in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, as required. Assess site conditions, asset quantities and condition, operational requirements, access restrictions, existing resources, and service delivery challenges. Verify available tender information against site observations and identify additional requirements that may affect cost or execution. Prepare detailed site visit reports documenting findings, photographs where permitted, discrepancies, risks, and pricing implications. 3. Comprehensive Cost Estimation Prepare detailed estimates covering all required hard and soft facilities management services, including MEP maintenance, civil works, cleaning, landscaping, pest control, waste management, and other services included in the tender. Develop manpower plans based on scope, asset quantities, service frequencies, productivity, working hours, shift coverage, and relief requirements. Estimate all relevant direct and indirect costs, including manpower, materials, consumables, spare parts, equipment, tools, vehicles, specialist subcontractors, accommodation, transportation, mobilization, demobilization, and site overheads. Account for applicable escalation, contingencies, contractual obligations, and other pricing risks in coordination with the Estimation Manager. Obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations, confirming technical compliance, scope completeness, exclusions, validity, and commercial terms. Benchmark estimates against historical project costs, operational feedback, and available market quotations. Develop cost optimization options while maintaining compliance with the required service levels. Maintain clear records of quantities, assumptions, calculations, quotations, and the basis of estimate. 4. Technical Proposal Coordination Coordinate closely with the Technical Writer to verify the accuracy and completeness of technical proposals for assigned tenders. Cross-check proposed methodologies, manpower schedules, organization charts, equipment lists, service frequencies, mobilization plans, and subcontracting arrangements against the priced scope. Identify and resolve inconsistencies between technical commitments and commercial allowances before submission. Coordinate with Operations, Procurement, HR, Finance, and relevant technical specialists to validate assumptions and confirm delivery feasibility. 5. Cost Review and Tender Submission Attend cost estimation review meetings with the Estimation Manager and relevant stakeholders. Present the estimate, pricing assumptions, key cost drivers, exclusions, risks, and proposed optimization measures. Prepare cost estimation summaries showing the principal cost components, commercial assumptions, and management-approved pricing adjustments. Incorporate review comments and maintain proper version control of estimates and supporting documents. Prepare and verify pricing schedules, bills of quantities, and commercial breakdowns in the client’s required format. Check calculations and ensure consistency across pricing documents before submission. Support responses to post-tender clarifications, revised pricing requests, and commercial negotiations. 6. Technical Presentations and PMO Handover Prepare technical presentations for projects priced, explaining the understanding of scope, proposed service delivery approach, manpower, equipment, mobilization, and key project considerations. Attend internal and client presentations as required and explain the technical and costing basis of the proposed solution. Prepare detailed cost estimation breakdowns for handover to the Project Management Office (PMO) following award. Provide PMO with approved budgets, manpower allocations, equipment provisions, subcontractor allowances, quotations, assumptions, exclusions, and identified risks. Participate in project handover meetings to ensure the execution team understands the priced scope and budget basis. Incorporate feedback from awarded projects into future estimates to improve accuracy. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil Engineering, or a relevant engineering discipline. Preferably 3–5 years of relevant experience in facilities management estimation, tendering, or costing. Demonstrated ability to estimate both hard and soft facilities management services. Experience preparing integrated FM tenders in Saudi Arabia is preferred. Experience with Aramco tenders and requirements is an advantage. Willingness and ability to travel throughout Saudi Arabia for site visits and tender meetings.

708e832df4edb470.description: About the Role Maaden is seeking a Principal Specialist Data Modeling & Arch (Operational Technology) to establish the data modeling and architecture foundation for Operational Technology (OT) and industrial data across its plants, sites, and operational systems in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for enabling trusted OT analytics by standardizing data representation, governance, and alignment with enterprise IT data products. Key Responsibilities Define enterprise OT data modeling standards for time-series data, events, alarms, assets, tags, measurements, and production contexts. Establish canonical OT concepts, including asset hierarchy, location hierarchy, tag naming, measurement definitions, and work order linkage. Design scalable data schemas for curated OT layers and reusable OT data products with auditability, lineage, and quality attributes. Architect OT-to-IT data alignment patterns that connect operational measurements with enterprise entities for reporting and analytics. Define integration rules for tag mapping, unit standardization, reference data, semantic consistency, and cross-site normalization. Embed governance-by-design into OT data models, including ownership, metadata, lineage, quality rules, and lifecycle controls. Define quality attributes for historian data, including compression, interpolation, quality flags, sampling frequency, and streaming patterns. Partner with OT engineering, cybersecurity, data platform, and infrastructure teams to design secure and compliant OT data flows. Review solution designs, data models, vendor deliverables, and integration approaches to ensure architectural consistency. Provide technical leadership on OT semantics, industrial data architecture, data modeling practices, and data product design. Coach engineers, data modelers, platform teams, and solution teams on OT modeling standards and implementation practices. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in data modeling and architecture, specifically within Operational Technology (OT) or industrial data environments. Demonstrated ability to define and implement enterprise OT data modeling standards for various data types. Experience in designing scalable data schemas and ensuring modeling patterns address high-volume industrial data and site variability. Proficiency in aligning historians, SCADA/DCS, condition monitoring, maintenance, reliability, and production data with enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data governance principles and their application to OT data models, including metadata, lineage, and quality rules. Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity requirements and designing secure OT data flows. Expected Outcomes Standard OT data models are defined and consistently adopted across sites, platforms, and industrial systems. Assets, tags, events, alarms, measurements, and production contexts are represented consistently for trusted analytics. OT-to-IT integration patterns enable reliable cross-domain reporting, performance analysis, and data product development. Curated OT layers include clear lineage, quality rules, auditability, and governance controls. Site onboarding, tag normalization, unit standardization, and data model reuse are accelerated through practical reference patterns. Technical Leadership and Mentorship The Principal Specialist will provide technical leadership in OT semantics and industrial data architecture. This includes coaching engineers and platform teams on modeling standards, leading design reviews for critical OT data initiatives, and building knowledge assets to accelerate consistent OT data architecture delivery. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be disclosed during the recruitment stages.

70c581d9b82e5e84.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صناع المراتب للصناعة عن مدير حسابات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف المباشر على أنشطة إدارة الحسابات، وضمان توافقها مع الأهداف والخطط التشغيلية للشركة، مع التركيز على الكفاءة والفعالية في العمليات اليومية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في صياغة الأهداف الرئيسية لإدارة الحسابات وتطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والمشروعات لتحقيقها، مع وضع مقاييس دقيقة لتقييم الإنجاز. مراجعة وتطوير سياسات وإجراءات إدارة الحسابات، ومتابعة تنفيذها، والإشراف على أداء الموظفين وتقييمهم لضمان الامتثال للمعايير المحاسبية. إدارة العمليات المحاسبية المتعلقة بالإيرادات والمدفوعات، وضمان دقة وفعالية عمليات التقييد والتدقيق والتسجيل في الدفاتر المحاسبية. الإشراف على عمليات الجرد السنوي، والتأكد من سلامة الإجراءات والسجلات، وإدارة تسوية الحسابات الشهرية والسنوية، وحفظ الوثائق وفقاً للمعايير المحاسبية. الإشراف على إعداد الملخصات والتقارير الحسابية وتقديمها للإدارة العليا، وإطلاعهم على التحديات والمستجدات، وتقديم الاستشارات بشأن القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة الحسابات أو دور مماثل. فهم عميق للمبادئ والمعايير المحاسبية المعتمدة. القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ السياسات والإجراءات المحاسبية. مهارات إشرافية وقيادية قوية لإدارة فرق العمل. متطلبات إضافية القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. مهارات تحليلية ممتازة وقدرة على حل المشكلات. القدرة على إعداد وتقديم التقارير المالية والإدارية. بيئة العمل سيعمل مدير الحسابات ضمن فريق مالي في شركة صناع المراتب للصناعة، وسيكون مسؤولاً عن ضمان سير العمليات المحاسبية بكفاءة عالية، مع توفير كافة الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لدعم الأنشطة اليومية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لشغل هذه الوظيفة في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية.

7009ce88abaaf2aa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة النخلات الثلاث للتجاره عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور تنفيذ جميع الأعمال المتعلقة بالتمديدات الكهربائية بكفاءة عالية، مع التركيز على الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية، وتشخيص الأعطال، وضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة المهنية. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة إجراءات تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية للتمديدات الكهربائية. تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية للمباني والمرافق المختلفة. متابعة تشغيل دارات التمديدات الكهربائية وفحصها، بما في ذلك فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات اللازمة لمعالجتها بفعالية. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع الأوقات. القيام بأي أعمال أخرى ذات صلة بهذا المجال أو أي مهام موكلة إليه ضمن نطاق مصلحة المشروع. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية. معرفة قوية بإجراءات فحص التمديدات الكهربائية (العازلية، الاستمرارية، التأريض). القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد حلولها. المهارات والكفاءات كفاءة عالية في تنفيذ الأعمال الموكلة. الالتزام بتطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. مهارات حل المشكلات والقدرة على العمل تحت الضغط. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمتابعة عملية التوظيف.

700cb12daf555845.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صفوة الرياض الخليجية عن فني ري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ أعمال الري الميدانية، مع التركيز على التوعية ومنع التعدي والتخريب على أنظمة الري. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية اختيار وتركيب أنظمة الري ومكوناتها بناءً على المتطلبات الزراعية والظروف البيئية مثل الرطوبة والارتفاع. معايرة أنظمة الري لضمان الاستهلاك الأمثل للمياه، ومراقبة هذه الأنظمة، وتقديم المشورة للمزارعين حول الاستخدام الصحيح. صيانة وإصلاح أنظمة الري، بالإضافة إلى أداء الصيانة الوقائية، واستكشاف المكونات المعيبة وإصلاحها. المساعدة في تصميم أنظمة ري جديدة أو محسنة، وتطبيق أحدث المنهجيات على الأنظمة الحالية. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات شهادة ثانوية عامة كحد أدنى. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. المهارات المطلوبة إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي. مهارة التواصل الفعال مع الجمهور. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل تقع في مدينة جدة بمنطقة مكة المكرمة، ويتطلب العمل الميداني والتعامل المباشر مع الجمهور والمزارعين. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

7076d4fd0620dcb4.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة المدينه الانشائية للمقاولات عن مشغل مضخة مياه للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، بمنطقة عسير. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية ضمان الجاهزية التشغيلية لمضخات مياه إطفاء الحرائق وتنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد مضخة مياه إطفاء الحرائق بشكل دوري وحسب الجدول الزمني المحدد. التحقق من جاهزية المضخة وتوافر المياه، وفتح صمامات مداخل ومخارج المياه. ربط خراطيم مياه الإطفاء بمخرج المضخة بطريقة صحيحة وآمنة. تشغيل المضخة عند نشوب أي حريق وفقًا لخطط العمل المتفق عليها ومراقبة أدائها. تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية لمضخة مياه إطفاء الحريق لضمان كفاءتها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 2 إلى 5 سنوات في تشغيل وصيانة مضخات المياه، ويفضل أن تكون في مضخات إطفاء الحرائق. القدرة على تفقد الأنظمة الميكانيكية وتحديد الأعطال البسيطة. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية المتعلقة بتشغيل المضخات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة أبها، عسير، وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لتفقد وتشغيل وصيانة المضخات بشكل منتظم. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه لتقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة المدينه الانشائية للمقاولات.

7084669d74e5a55c.description: Job Title: Manager, Procurement & Supply Chain (Healthcare Experience Required) Department: Procurement & Supply Chain Management The Manager of Procurement & Supply Chain owns vendor and contract risk for QHC from Day-1 and builds the procurement and supply-chain capability the organization needs as it scales through the startup phase. The role ensures that sourcing, contracting and supplier management are governed, compliant and value-driven. The role establishes the policies, processes and controls that let QHC procure at pace without compromising governance. The role works across clinical, technology, facilities and enabling functions, and coordinates with QIC shared services and third-party providers, to ensure the reliable, cost-effective and compliant supply of medical and non-medical goods and services. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES 1. Procurement Strategy & Planning • Develop and maintain QHC's procurement plan aligned with startup priorities, activation milestones and budget, including category strategies for medical, technology, facilities and professional services. • Forecast demand and lead times and sequence sourcing activity to meet Day-1 and scale-up needs. • Advise leadership on make-versus-buy and leverage-from-QIC decisions across categories. 2. Sourcing, Tendering & Contract Management • Lead sourcing, tendering and competitive evaluation processes with fairness, transparency and auditability. • Negotiate and structure contracts, service agreements and framework arrangements that protect QHC commercially and operationally. • Maintain the contract register, manage renewals and expiries, and ensure obligations are tracked and met. 3. Supply Chain & Inventory Management • Establish supply-chain and inventory processes across medical consumables, pharmaceuticals, equipment and non-medical supplies. • Ensure availability, traceability and appropriate stock levels for clinical and operational continuity, minimizing waste and stock-outs. • Coordinate logistics, warehousing and distribution arrangements as required. 5. Governance, Compliance & Risk • Implement procurement policies, delegation of authority, controls and segregation of duties to mitigate financial and compliance risk. • Ensure compliance with Saudi procurement and regulatory requirements and with QIC service and governance frameworks. • Maintain audit readiness, procurement records and risk registers for internal and external review. 6. Cost Optimization & Value Delivery • Drive cost efficiency, value-for-money and total-cost-of-ownership discipline across procurement decisions. • Identify and deliver savings, consolidation and demand-management opportunities without compromising quality or continuity. • Provide procurement input to budgeting, business cases and capital planning. 7. Systems, Process & Capability • Support the implementation and use of e-procurement and supply-chain systems and dashboards. • Standardize procurement processes and build internal capability as the function grows. • Provide clear procurement reporting and analytics to Finance and leadership. EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field is required. A professional certification (CIPS, CPSM, or equivalent) and / or a Master's degree is preferred. 6+ years of progressive experience in procurement and supply-chain management, including sourcing, tendering, contract negotiation and vendor management, ideally within healthcare, construction / facilities, or large project / startup environments. Demonstrated experience owning vendor and contract risk and establishing procurement processes and controls. Experience with medical / pharmaceutical supply chains and with accredited healthcare environments is an advantage. Working knowledge of Saudi procurement and regulatory requirements and of operating within shared-services or SLA-based models. Strong commercial, negotiation and analytical capability.
